# Bhimesh Chauhan

> Lead AI platform engineer (10+ years of production software) operating at staff scope, with experience embedded with customer teams. Builds and runs production RAG and LLM systems end to end, from retrieval architecture to launch-day reliability, and leads teams of 4-5 engineers and designers. Currently Lead Software Engineer at Rare Days.

Location: Canada. Permanent resident, authorized to work in Canada for any employer, no sponsorship needed.
Availability: open to contract work (preferred) and full-time roles; can start immediately. Contract engagements as a sole proprietor or through a corporation, 8 to 40 hours a week depending on the needs of the business. Works Pacific and Eastern time zones. US companies are engaged as an independent contractor working from Canada.
Has lived and worked in Canada, the United States and Spain.

Roles of interest: forward deployed engineer, staff / principal AI platform engineer, lead / founding engineer. Every claim below is backed by a case study on this site. Full detail is in /llms-full.txt; structured data is in /resume.json.

## Leadership
- [Leading several projects at once: scope, time and stakeholders](https://bhimeshchauhan.com/blog/#post-9): balancing customer feature requests against the timeline and what a team can deliver, and keeping the VP of Engineering, CTO and CEO free of surprises; grounded in the Jefferson Fisher launch.

## Case studies (shipped work, with measurable outcomes)
- [Jefferson Fisher launch platform](https://bhimeshchauhan.com/case-studies/jefferson-fisher/): led engineering for a client launch at Rare Days; about $700K USD in total sales in under 48 hours; Next.js, Stripe, queue-protected checkout.
- [Ask Kindred](https://bhimeshchauhan.com/case-studies/ask-kindred/): production RAG assistant, SDK integration to production for three customer companies, about 200 daily active users; multi-tenant, grounded retrieval with citations.
- [Scrubs Co-Pilot](https://bhimeshchauhan.com/case-studies/scrubs-copilot/): founded and built an ambient clinical AI platform (Whisper, RAG, LLM); about 80% less clinician documentation time.
- [Wrangle](https://bhimeshchauhan.com/case-studies/wrangle/): mobile and platform engineering (Expo, NestJS, Supabase); 1,000+ automated tests, 46 migrations, 3 automated deploy pipelines.
- [RAG Portfolio Assistant](https://bhimeshchauhan.com/case-studies/rag-portfolio-assistant/): the grounded assistant on this site (pgvector, Supabase Edge Functions); live and public.
- [PDF-to-Audiobook](https://bhimeshchauhan.com/case-studies/pdf-to-audiobook/): NLP and TTS pipeline with NER, coreference and speaker attribution.
